questions.q: The South Coast Railway (SCoR), which became Indian Railways' 18th railway zone in May 2026, has its headquarters at ___
questions.explain: The South Coast Railway (SCoR), the 18th zone of Indian Railways, is headquartered at Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh.

questions.q: In May 2026, the Union Cabinet first approved raising the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges (excluding the Chief Justice of India) from 33 to ___
questions.explain: The Cabinet approved raising the strength from 33 to 37 judges (excluding the Chief Justice of India); the increase was later notified through an Ordinance.

questions.q: The Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Act, 2025 replaced which rural employment law?
options: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)
Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana
questions.explain: The Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Act replaced the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) from 1 July 2026, raising the guarantee to 125 days.

questions.q: Under the VB-G RAM G Act, the wage-cost sharing between the Centre and states (other than North-Eastern and Himalayan states) is ___
questions.explain: Under the Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) (VB-G RAM G) Act, wages are shared 60:40 between Centre and states, and 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan states.

questions.q: Parveen Shaikh won the Whitley Award 2026 (the 'Green Oscar') for the conservation of which bird?
questions.explain: Parveen Shaikh won the Whitley Award for conserving the Indian Skimmer along the Chambal river.

questions.q: Who was appointed Chairman of Prasar Bharati in May 2026?
questions.explain: Lyricist and advertising professional Prasoon Joshi became Chairman of Prasar Bharati, India's public broadcaster.

questions.q: Who was appointed Chairperson of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC) in May 2026?
questions.explain: Shashi Shekhar Vempati, former Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Prasar Bharati, became Chairperson of the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC).

questions.q: Who became a Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in May 2026?
questions.explain: Rohit Jain was appointed a Deputy Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) in May 2026.

questions.q: N. Rangasamy took oath in May 2026 as Chief Minister of Puducherry for the ___ time.
questions.explain: N. Rangasamy became Chief Minister (CM) of Puducherry for a record fifth time on 13 May 2026.

questions.q: Which state became India's first fully paperless judiciary state and the first fully literate state (99.82% literacy) in May 2026?
questions.explain: Sikkim became the first fully paperless judiciary state and was declared fully literate under the Understanding Lifelong Learning for All in Society (ULLAS) programme.

questions.q: In the Henley Passport Index 2026, India's rank was ___
questions.explain: India ranked 78th in the Henley Passport Index 2026, with visa-free or visa-on-arrival access to 56 destinations.

questions.q: In the World Press Freedom Index 2026 (by Reporters Without Borders), India ranked ___ out of 180 countries.
questions.explain: India ranked 157th of 180 in the World Press Freedom Index 2026; Norway ranked first. The index is published by Reporters Without Borders (RSF).

questions.q: Which book won the International Booker Prize 2026?
questions.explain: 'Taiwan Travelogue' won the International Booker Prize 2026, awarded for translated fiction.

questions.q: In May 2026, Prime Minister Modi received the Royal Order of the Polar Star from which country?
questions.explain: Sweden conferred its Royal Order of the Polar Star on Prime Minister (PM) Modi in May 2026; Norway separately gave him the Grand Cross of the Royal Norwegian Order of Merit.

questions.q: India upgraded its relations with which European country to a 'Special Strategic Partnership' in May 2026?
questions.explain: India and Italy elevated their ties to a Special Strategic Partnership in May 2026.

questions.q: The India–Africa Forum Summit scheduled for May 2026 was postponed due to concerns over ___
questions.explain: The India–Africa Forum Summit was postponed over Ebola outbreak concerns in Africa.

questions.q: The Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool (BMIP), approved in May 2026, is administered by ___
options: Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI)
questions.explain: The Bharat Maritime Insurance Pool (BMIP), a $1.5 billion pool with a $1.4 billion sovereign guarantee, is administered by the General Insurance Corporation Re (GIC Re).

questions.q: The SARTHAK-PDS scheme, approved with an outlay of ₹25,530 crore, aims to modernise ___
questions.explain: SARTHAK-PDS modernises the Public Distribution System (PDS), which supplies subsidised foodgrains through fair price shops.

questions.q: The two semiconductor units approved in May 2026 under the India Semiconductor Mission are located in which state?
questions.explain: A Mini/Micro light-emitting diode (LED) fab at Dholera and an Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT) unit at Surat were approved in Gujarat.

questions.q: In May 2026, the Supreme Court held that timely emergency trauma care is a fundamental right under which Article of the Constitution?
questions.explain: The Supreme Court held that emergency trauma care falls under Article 21 (Right to Life) of the Constitution.

questions.q: The Supreme Court in May 2026 upheld the 28% Goods and Services Tax (GST) levy on ___
questions.explain: The Court upheld 28% Goods and Services Tax (GST) on online gaming, treating such platforms as suppliers of actionable claims.

questions.q: According to the Sample Registration System (SRS) 2024, India's Total Fertility Rate (TFR) is ___
questions.explain: The Sample Registration System (SRS) 2024 put India's Total Fertility Rate (TFR) at 1.9, below the replacement level of 2.1.

questions.q: In May 2026, the Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) seized about 227.7 kg of Captagon tablets in its first-ever such seizure under which operation?
questions.explain: Operation Ragepill was the Narcotics Control Bureau's (NCB) first Captagon seizure, worth about ₹182 crore.

questions.q: Which state passed its Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill in May 2026 (after Uttarakhand)?
questions.explain: The Assam Assembly passed the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) Bill on 27 May 2026.

questions.q: The National Critical Mineral Mission (NCMC) approved in May 2026 deals with ___
options: Critical minerals for clean energy and defence
questions.explain: The National Critical Mineral Mission (NCMC) secures minerals such as lithium and cobalt needed for clean energy and defence.

questions.q: In May 2026, the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) signed an agreement with which institution for Aadhaar-related research?
questions.explain: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) tied up with the National Forensic Sciences University (NFSU) for research and training.

questions.q: National Technology Day is observed on 11 May to commemorate ___
options: The founding of the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)
questions.explain: National Technology Day (11 May) marks the Pokhran-II nuclear tests conducted on 11 May 1998.

questions.q: The theme of the International Day for Biological Diversity 2026 (22 May) was ___
questions.explain: The International Day for Biological Diversity is observed on 22 May; the 2026 theme was 'Acting locally for global impact'.

questions.q: Yoweri Museveni was sworn in in May 2026 for a seventh term as President of which country?
questions.explain: Yoweri Museveni began a seventh term as President of Uganda in May 2026.

questions.q: The Keliber project, inaugurated in May 2026 as Europe's first fully integrated lithium project, is in which country?
questions.explain: Finland's Keliber is Europe's first fully integrated lithium project, from mine to battery chemicals.

questions.q: The subsea gas pipeline planned from Oman to Gujarat (₹40,000 crore) will be led by which Indian company?
questions.explain: GAIL (India) Limited will lead the Oman-to-Gujarat subsea gas pipeline project.

questions.q: The Vadinar ship repair complex approved in May 2026 (₹1,570 crore) is located in which state?
questions.explain: The Vadinar ship repair complex will come up in Gujarat, near the Vadinar port and refinery area.

questions.q: The Cabinet Committee on Climate and Disaster (CCDB) approved in May 2026 is chaired by ___
questions.explain: The Cabinet Committee on Climate and Disaster (CCDB) is chaired by the Prime Minister (PM).

questions.q: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) in May 2026 issued an advisory mainly about ___
questions.explain: The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) warned hospitals against rising ransomware attacks.

questions.q: The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) hydrogen bus service in Delhi's Central Vista area uses buses provided by ___
questions.explain: The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) hydrogen shuttle buses were provided by Indian Oil.

questions.q: India signed a critical minerals cooperation framework with which country in May 2026?
questions.explain: India and the United States signed a critical minerals cooperation framework in May 2026.

questions.q: Which Indian state launched the 'CG Dial' emergency service on the lines of a single emergency number in May 2026?
questions.explain: 'CG Dial' is Chhattisgarh's integrated emergency response service launched in May 2026.

questions.q: The Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) extension approved in May 2026 mainly supports ___
options: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) and airlines
questions.explain: The Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) provides collateral-free guaranteed credit, mainly to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).

questions.q: India's first Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) blending facility approved in May 2026 is associated with which sector body?
questions.explain: Standards for Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) blending were framed through the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS).

questions.q: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) held its 59th annual meeting in May 2026 at ___
questions.explain: The Asian Development Bank (ADB) held its 59th annual meeting in Samarkand, Uzbekistan.
